Delivery devices differ in their ability to set fractional in spired concentrations of oxygen (FiO2) 

- Variable: Deliver a fluctuating FiO2 depending on device and patient factors
- Fixed: Deliver a constant/predictable FiO2 regardless of TV/inspiratory flow rate 

Variability in FIO2 delivery for variable devises is dependent on peak inspiratory flow. 

For a 70kg adult with RR 12 and TV of 500ml and I:E Ratio 1:4

500ml in 1sec = inspiratory flow rate of 30l/min

All devices operate with O2 Flow rates under 30l/min and therefore will deliver FiO2\<1. The faster the inspiratory flow rate the lower the FiO2 delivered.
